## What lands

- **`ops/basemap.lock.json` (`sig.basemap-lock/1`)** — the pin: upstream bases; the measured `20260930.pmtiles` reference (138.5 GB, z0–15, schema 4.15.2, rotated upstream); the `@protomaps/basemaps` 5.7.2 v4↔5.x pairing; glyph/context/host/serving/refresh/cost blocks; the verbatim plan cells.
- **`sig-ops basemap`** (`ops/src/ops/basemap.py` + `cli.py`) — `lock | check | glyphs fetch|verify | context-build | refresh | host | kill-switch`. `check` proves the whole posture offline (lock contract → styles bound to the lock → glyph tree re-hashes → CSP admits the tile origin → alert + kill-switch declared). `refresh --apply` is the real leg — `builds.json` resolve → stream-download verifying the published **b3sum** → versioned-key upload with immutable cache-control → `host.served` + 30-day previous retention — behind `apply_gate` (exit 42 + verbatim re-run prompt; AR-3 windows). `host --apply` does the three Cloudflare calls (bucket → CORS → custom domain). `kill-switch` flips `serving.active_source → context`.
- **Generated styles** (`web/scripts/gen-map-styles.mjs` → `web/public/map/style-{light,dark,context}.json`, `--verify`ed in `npm run check`) — grayscale/black flavours; drops `address_label`/`roads_shields`/`roads_oneway`; strips every `icon-image` (**no sprite sheet**); buildings ≥ z15, road labels ≥ z13; `lang: en`; `sig:basemap` metadata binding each doc to the lock.
- **Self-hosted glyphs** — Noto Sans Regular + Italic, 256 ranges each + `OFL.txt` + `sig.basemap-glyphs/1` manifest (root stamped into the lock), same-origin under `/map/fonts/` — works under every posture incl. the context fallback.
- **`context.pmtiles` (`sig.context-tiles/1`)** — built by `basemap context-build` from JUR-01's verified boundary pack: country/state/county outlines + place-name points, z0–10, public domain, same-origin, never the tile host (K1 §2.6).
- **`web/src/lib/basemap.ts` + CSP** — the TS contract mirror (`assertBasemapStyleContract`) and `connect-src 'self' https://tiles.surveillancegraph.org`.
- **`ops/basemap.alert.json` (`sig.basemap-alert/1`)** + **`docs/build/reports/p36.33-basemap-host/`** packet — usage thresholds, the two-level kill switch, preconditions, header-verify checklist, restore point, exact re-run prompt.
- **ADR-229** (registered: spec_src row + spec rebuilt, ADR index regen, `ADR_TRIGGERS.csv` quiet row, `BL-086` cite) + CHANGELOG + spend-ledger row + DEFERRALS `D-P36.33-1` (+ `obligation-event/1` anchor, `return_pass.toml` row).
